headline: In Kyrgyzstan, various types of transport carried more than 577 million people
summary: All transport types in Kyrgyzstan carried 577.1 million passengers from January to October 2026. Passenger traffic grew 8.3 percent year on year over the ten-month period.
why: Passenger transport volumes are a practical gauge of household mobility and activity in transport and services sectors. Growth in these figures reflects broader domestic economic conditions.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане различные виды транспорта перевезли более 577 миллионов человек
